primary_grid.expansion_policy: Do not expand after observing outcomes without an explicit later decision record.

schedule_policy: M05/M06 may define the exact numerical stimulus schedule before first execution, but may not add post-hoc scenario categories to rescue a preferred result.
neighborhood_policy: The later selected setting must be surrounded by a small declared neighborhood as required by the architecture.
scientific_status: Search candidates are project model assumptions, not measured physiology.
m04_execution_prohibition: Do not execute behavioral calibration during M04.
